description: Energy curve between the two atoms of a measured diatomic molecule: bond length, well depth (De), REAL dissociation energy (D0) and zero-point energy. D0 is NOT De — the molecule is never at rest at the bottom of the well, not even at 0 K, and in H2 the difference is 0.27 eV. Covalent bonds use Morse, noble gases use Lennard-Jones.

molecule.description: H2, N2, O2, F2, Cl2, HF, HCl, Li2, Na2, He2, Ne2, Ar2, Kr2, Xe2

name: bond_energy
